title: Underdraw
description:
Underdraw itself: an agentic collaboration tool where one user and several AI agents plan and track Projects → Features → Tasks, stored as committed text files under `.underdraw/`. `Requirements.md` is the authoritative spec.

Already built (steps 1–2 of the build order): the data model and `.underdraw/` file store, the service layer, the MCP server, the Connect API and `underdraw serve`.
